name: ucler-sinematik
description: ucler sinematik hikâye videoları (Remotion). Sitenin paketinden ayrıdır.

scripts.render: remotion render $npm_config_comp out/ham.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/ham.mp4 -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_range tv -crf 21 -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart out/$npm_config_comp.mp4
